summary: Ovid Therapeutics Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the expiration and exercise of Series A Warrants from an October 2025 private placement. Investors exercised 33,597,860 common shares at $1.40/share and 4,883,464 pre-funded warrants at $1.399/share, yielding ~$53.9 million gross proceeds. This is a routine capital event with no special-situation mechanics like a tender offer, restructuring, or strategic change; it is simply a warrant exercise disclosure.
